Trump and his MAGA acolytes will do anything they can to suppress votes in the midterms. They are so scared of the voice of the people that they're willing to try and use the USPS to reject and toss out your legitimate ballot.
RUSH $35 or more to fight these suppressive policies, defend mail-in voting, and make every voice heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=062926_4&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Let us be very clear, Team: The Constitution places the authority to run elections squarely with the states and Congress – not with the Executive branch .
However, Trump has issued executive order after executive order, trying to impose sweeping new federal controls over our elections.
His latest executive order, targeting the USPS, is just another unlawful attempt by this MAGA administration to sow chaos ahead of the fall midterm elections. We cannot allow overreach of this magnitude to go unchecked.
Fuel our work to protect our fundamental right to vote with $35 or whatever you can today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=062926_4&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=062926_4&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=062926_4&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=062926_4&amount=50]

Trump's executive order purports to address “noncitizen voting,” which is one of his obsessions. Instead, the latest executive order is dangerous, unlawful, and harmful to voters.
Here's the truth:
➜ States already have proven systems in place to verify voter eligibility
➜ Noncitizen voting is already a federal crime
➜ Instances of noncitizen voting are incredibly rare
Rather than solving actual problems, Trump is prioritizing his fever dreams and fears about losing the midterms to manufacture problems. MAGA is desperate to justify granting the federal government unprecedented authority over an election process that the Constitution clearly delegates to the states and to Congress.
We can't sit by and stay silent while our right to vote is attacked. Help us fight back with $35 or whatever you can to protect mail-in voting and stop Trump's suppressive policies >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=062926_4&amount=35]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

body:
Peter

My name is Melanie Lucero, and I'm running to be the Republican nominee for Congress in Virginia's 5th District.

I'm a United States Marine Corps veteran, former Intelligence Community member, small business owner, and housing expert. I'm not a career politician. I'm running because our district deserves a representative who fights for the people, not the political establishment.

Early voting is NOW OPEN, and Republican Primary Election Day is August 4.

This is an unusual time of year to hold an election in Virginia, and many voters don't realize voting has already begun. That's why your vote and support are so important.

When elected, I'll fight to lower costs, eliminate government fraud, waste, and abuse, improve healthcare access and reduce high premiums, defend our constitutional freedoms, protect the Second Amendment, secure our border, and always put America First.

Campaigns shouldn't be won by special interests. They should be won by hardworking Americans who believe we can do better.

If you're able, please consider making a contribution today. Individuals may contribute up to $3,500 and couples up to $7,000, but every dollar helps us reach more voters and grow this grassroots campaign.

He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards. After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA 's collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. This resulted in White demanding that the NBA, as a representative of the global corporate community, take up the responsibility of spearheading the mental health conversation - not just posturing through press statements, but through policy. Royce then went on to win two championships in Canada before moving over to play Big 3 Basketball. White appeared at a game in a t-shirt that read "Free The Uyghurs." After a game-winning basket, White did a post-game interview on CBS, where he called for 2 Million Uyghurs to be freed and released from concentration camps. As the season went on, White would touch on taboo topics such as Gain of Function Research, The Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Larry Hoover, Jeff Fort, Muammar Gaddafi, The Great Reset, Ivermectin, Me Too, etc. Now, Royce White is running for Senate in Minnesota to take down the Radical Left. Republicans have not seen recent success in Minnesota, but Royce's campaign is different: a grassroots movement that's sick of the Radical Agenda pushed by Far Left Democrats Tina Smith and Ilhan Omar. Royce needs your help to pull off a fourth quarter comeback victory and FLIP Minnesota Red for Republicans. PAID FOR BY ROYCE WHITE FOR SENATE P.O. We’re a little behind, but we can catch up with your help.
#
Peter,
Right now, millions of eligible Latino voters are still unregistered, even though upcoming elections in key states could be decided by razor-thin margins.
That’s the gap we’re working on closing. Which is why we’ve set a critical goal to raise **$30,000 by tomorrow at midnight** to fully fund this urgent work. And right now, we’re exactly **52% of the way there.**
[](https://act.votolatino.org/go/68?c0=em-ms-voto-20260629-2.T_tlGn&refcode=em20260629-324&t=1&akid=324%2E1366028%2EvDqnrh)
As you can see, we still have a way to go, and the clock is ticking. **[Can you rush $26 — the cost of registering one voter — right now to help us reach our goal by June 30 and register Latino voters?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/68?c0=em-ms-voto-20260629-2.T_tlGn&refcode=em20260629-324&t=2&akid=324%2E1366028%2EvDqnrh)**
Our organizing is focused on finding those unregistered voters, helping them register, and turning them out, because when Latino voters participate at full strength, we can change election outcomes.
But Trump and anti-democracy politicians know the strength and power Latinos have when we show up in big numbers. That’s why they’re pushing voter suppression laws and attacks meant to discourage our communities from participating.
Our path to building a movement they can’t ignore is simple. Register more Latino voters, mobilize them, and show up at the ballot box.
**[Will you chip in $26 right now to help us close the gap and hit our goal by tomorrow at midnight?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/68?c0=em-ms-voto-20260629-2.T_tlGn&refcode=em20260629-324&t=3&akid=324%2E1366028%2EvDqnrh)**

Thank you,
Voto Latino

body:
$5, Peter.
That's the amount I'm asking you to split between my campaign for Governor of Georgia and Gina Hinojosa before the June 30 fundraising deadline.
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260629_3_bottoms.ne4zEX&amount=5&refcode=em20260629-1459&t=1&akid=1459%2E299639%2EDJqKwp)
$5 because Donald Trump and his allies are working every day to drag our country backward.
$5 because Georgia has always been on the front lines of the fight for our democracy.
$5 because the decisions we make in this election won't just shape the next four years — they'll shape the future of our state for a generation.
**_$5 because I’m facing my first end-of-quarter fundraising deadline since becoming the official Democratic nominee for Governor of Georgia, and I need your help._**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260629_3_bottoms.ne4zEX&amount=5&refcode=em20260629-1459&t=2&akid=1459%2E299639%2EDJqKwp)
You might think a single $5 contribution can't make much of a difference in a race as important as this one.
But campaigns like ours aren't powered by billionaires or corporate special interests.
They're powered by people: Teachers. Nurses. Students. Retirees. Working families.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260629_3_bottoms.ne4zEX&amount=5&refcode=em20260629-1459&t=3&akid=1459%2E299639%2EDJqKwp)
People chipping in $5, $10, or $25 because they believe Georgia deserves leadership that will fight for affordable housing, good jobs, strong public schools, reproductive freedom, and the right to vote.
And when enough people step up, it adds up fast.
That's how we build the grassroots campaign it will take to win and fight back against the flood of MAGA money that is already pouring into Georgia.
**[So today, I'm asking: Will you split a $5 contribution between my campaign for Governor of Georgia and Gina Hinojosa's campaign for Governor of Texas before the June 30 end-of-quarter deadline? My team and I will put your donation to work immediately, reaching voters, organizing communities, and building the campaign we need to move Georgia forward.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260629_3_bottoms.ne4zEX&refcode=em20260629-1459&amount=5&t=4&akid=1459%2E299639%2EDJqKwp)**

Thank you for being part of this fight.
Gratefully,
Keisha Lance Bottoms

my name is Cait Conley, and I am the official Democratic nominee against Mike Lawler in NY-17. I’m a proud fourth-generation Hudson Valley native from a blue-collar family. After graduating from West Point, I spent 16 years as an active-duty Army officer, deploying six times overseas to keep America safe. Now, I’m running for Congress in one of the toughest battleground districts in the entire country. This is one of only three House districts nationwide that split their ticket for Kamala Harris and a Republican member of Congress in 2024. Lawler is beatable – but only if we’re able to go toe-to-toe with him, communicating with voters across the district. name: Roy Cooper
subject: A long email but one worth reading:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
10,000 votes 10 years ago
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260629_3.S85V4e&refcode=em20260629-3&t=1&akid=7478%2E582294%2EemXcNU)
At the end of this message, I’m going to ask you to split a $5 donation to my Senate campaign here in North Carolina and Chris Pappas. **[If you’re ready to give now, you can use this link to donate.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260629_3.S85V4e&refcode=em20260629-3&t=2&akid=7478%2E582294%2EemXcNU)**
**Otherwise, please let me explain why your support is so important and what could happen without it.**
In 2016, I ran for Governor for the first time.
I was fighting to unseat Republican Governor Pat McCrory. Nobody had defeated an incumbent Governor in North Carolina for over 150 years, but I knew that we had the team behind us to win and make history.
Throughout the race, multiple election experts were saying it was a “Toss Up.” Poll after poll showed me with a slight — or sometimes even large — lead. The momentum was on our side.
**However, on Election Night, the race was too close to call.**
I ended that night with a less than 5,000-vote lead — which might sound like a lot but is a razor-thin margin in North Carolina, especially given the 4.6 million ballots cast. It was less than half of 1%.
Governor McCrory didn’t concede. He claimed that there had been voter fraud in our state with no evidence to back it up.
He called for a recount, and over the next month, he and his team continued spreading baseless conspiracy theories and undermining faith in the democratic process.
**Yet on Dec. 5, 2016, democracy won. The recount was wrapped up, and the results were in: We had won the race by 10,277 votes.**
This current Senate race is starting to remind me a lot of my 2016 race.
Just like in 2016, the momentum today appears to be on our side.
Experts are calling this race a “Toss Up.” Even though President Trump carried North Carolina each of the three times he ran. Even the experts are saying that this is the best chance for Democrats to flip a Republican-held seat in the country.
Here’s what worries me...
**We could have just as easily lost that race in 2016. Despite all of the winds blowing in our favor, we still only won by 10,277 votes — just 0.22%.**
That’s why we simply cannot take our foot off the gas. We cannot look at the polls and the predictions and think for a second that we have this in the bag. We cannot give our Republican opponent or the right-wing super PACs supporting him an inch.
**I won in 2016 — in the same election that President Trump first won the presidency — only because of grassroots support from people like you. That’s how I plan to win again, but I need you with me.**
**[Please: Will you split a $5 donation, or whatever you can, between our campaign and Chris Pappas before our end-of-quarter deadline to help us flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260629_3.S85V4e&refcode=em20260629-3&t=3&akid=7478%2E582294%2EemXcNU)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260629_3.S85V4e&amount=5&refcode=em20260629-3&t=22&akid=7478%2E582294%2EemXcNU)**
Thank you for reading. I appreciate it.
Roy Cooper

And it comes back to something really simple: it’s about being seen. The significance of visibility for queer people of all ages cannot be overstated. When I first ran for Congress, the visibility and representation my candidacy was able to grant folks in my district who felt otherwise unseen was the center of my campaign. It continues to inspire the work I do as the first queer Latina in the House of Representatives. I’m doing this for queers kids all over my district and I’m doing this for her: [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134283312/630752466/1131826177?amount=25&refcode=RS_EM_EN_2026.06.29_Pride&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkN2ZlYTVlYS0yMzc0LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Awg6KC0CqIMakmw_Y2EEcIvycFTlnpIwzddDybME6c0=) Growing up, I didn’t see people like me in elected positions. But I saw pieces of myself everywhere else. I saw myself in Rogue from the X-Men comics. In Xena: Warrior Princess. In Buffy, in Willow. I watched Ellen come out on national television with my mom, and I didn’t fully understand why it felt so important at the time, but it did. I went to Lilith Fair at the Gorge in 1999, the same day Brandi Chastain scored the winning penalty kick in the Women’s World Cup Final and took her shirt off. (I’m not saying those two things are related, but I’m also not not saying that.) Those moments mattered because they were little flashes of recognition. Like the world briefly saying:**you exist, you belong here too.** That’s what Pride is to me. It’s not just a celebration. It’s visibility. It’s survival. And that’s why what’s happening right now matters so much. **We are watching real attempts to erase transgender people from public life and we’re just not going to take it.** Because Pride has always been a refusal to disappear. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134283313/630752467/1131826177?amount=25&refcode=RS_EM_EN_2026.06.29_Pride&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkN2ZlYTVlYS0yMzc0LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Awg6KC0CqIMakmw_Y2EEcIvycFTlnpIwzddDybME6c0=) Thank you for fighting with me for visibility and freedom for all of us 💙 — Emily | | Emily Randall is proud to represent Washington’s 6th District in Congress. clean_body: | Peter, I’ve been thinking about what Pride means to me this year. And it comes back to something really simple: it’s about being seen. The significance of visibility for queer people of all ages cannot be overstated. When I first ran for Congress, the visibility and representation my candidacy was able to grant folks in my district who felt otherwise unseen was the center of my campaign. It continues to inspire the work I do as the first queer Latina in the House of Representatives. I’m doing this for queers kids all over my district and I’m doing this for her: = Growing up, I didn’t see people like me in elected positions. But I saw pieces of myself everywhere else. I saw myself in Rogue from the X-Men comics. In Xena: Warrior Princess. In Buffy, in Willow. I watched Ellen come out on national television with my mom, and I didn’t fully understand why it felt so important at the time, but it did. I went to Lilith Fair at the Gorge in 1999, the same day Brandi Chastain scored the winning penalty kick in the Women’s World Cup Final and took her shirt off. (I’m not saying those two things are related, but I’m also not not saying that.) Those moments mattered because they were little flashes of recognition. Like the world briefly saying:you exist, you belong here too. That’s what Pride is to me. It’s not just a celebration. It’s visibility. It’s survival. And that’s why what’s happening right now matters so much. We are watching real attempts to erase transgender people from public life and we’re just not going to take it. Because Pride has always been a refusal to disappear. = Thank you for fighting with me for visibility and freedom for all of us 💙 — Emily | | Emily Randall is proud to represent Washington’s 6th District in Congress. She grew up in a working-class Union household in Port Orchard and was the first in her family to attend college. # **Indiana tops list for cheapest gas prices in the country, thanks to Braun 's gas tax suspension**

Gov. Mike Braun said he might suspend the state's gasoline use tax if the war with Iran drags on for several weeks. (WISH photo/Garrett Bergquist)_ INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) -- Indiana has the cheapest regular gasoline of any state in the country, according to [AAA Fuel Prices](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fnkdg-hhlljjcji-i/).Governor Mike Braun on Wednesday said that thanks to the suspension of the gasoline usage tax and excise tax, Hoosiers have had the cheapest gas in the country for a month."Affordability is my top priority. Since I suspended Indiana's gas taxes, Hoosiers have had the cheapest gas prices in the country. Those savings are a big benefit for families trying to make ends meet at the kitchen table. Making life more affordable for Hoosiers will always be priority one," Braun said in a release.According to AAA's report, Braun's decision to suspend the gas taxes dropped the average gasoline cost paid by Hoosiers by 61 cents per gallon over the last month. Indiana's average gas price is 60 cents per gallon less than the national average. I'm writing this from a boat in the Tsugaru Strait in Japan where my husband is going to make history.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5c6307ca-7569-49a9-8759-d787a3541adb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The water between Honshu and Hokkaido is deep blue and cold and moving in ways you can't see from shore. On the port side, my husband Rob is swimming toward Hokkaido. He's been swimming for 8 hours and has gone over 18 miles/30 km. He'll be swimming for ten to fifteen total and will cover 25-28 miles/40-45 km
Yesterday I did a 30-minute ocean swim in the same water. In a wetsuit. I was freezing. Rob will be out here for ten to fifteen hours in nothing but a Speedo, a cap, and goggles. No wetsuit allowed. He's coated head to toe in diaper rash cream -- zinc -- because it's the only sun protection that stays on through that many hours of salt water. That's why he's glowing white out there. War paint, basically.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/952dcccd-6db7-4bc6-bd28-19387f3a214c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
To survive the cold, he's gained 20 to 30 pounds of brown fat for insulation. He intentionally remade his body into a different kind of machine. We talk a lot about loving the bodies we have. Rob keeps redefining what a body can even do.
If he reaches the other side, he becomes the first person in history to complete the Double Seven -- the Seven Summits and the Oceans Seven. Every continent's highest peak. Every one of the seven hardest open-water channels on earth.
Sixteen years. fifteen expeditions (because it's our second time on Tsugaru). One last swim. Follow the tracker here:
[https://live.garmin.com/session/4535967f-f025-8256-ace5-1e74102d2e01/token/385B6549885A80B2A617BCF6BD0A3D0](https://substack.com/redirect/f2eafe53-bfe5-445c-8cb8-7d8932200c4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Tsugaru is the one that got away. In 2023 he was pulled from this same water, told he wouldn't make the time limit. He came home, said almost nothing about it, and started training again. The record is the headline. The years of getting back in the cold are the actual story.
Right now, he's battling a strong 4.6 knot current that is pulling him off course. We can't physically fight it. So he keeps swimming as the coast he's trying to land on gets further and further away.
Here's what it actually takes, from where I'm sitting.
He can't touch the boat. Not once. Any assistance and the swim is over. So every hour I toss him a bottle on a retractable dog leash -- 350 calories of liquid nutrition, the only fuel he gets. He drinks it treading water and keeps going. I tried to swim alongside him earlier with fins on. I couldn't keep up. He doesn't have fins.
The cost of this stuff is real, and it isn't pretty. After Molokai, he developed SIPE -- swimming-induced pulmonary edema -- two days later and ended up in the ER. In the English Channel and the North Channel, he was stung by jellyfish hundreds of times and kept swimming. On Everest, both our bodies were slowly dying at altitude. On Vinson, in Antarctica, we battled 40 below.
We've learned not to ask each other how we're doing in the middle of these things. The question only makes you remember the pain. So instead we just say, "You're doing good, yah?" Not a question, really. A reminder. A small act of holding each other up across cold water.
There's something in both of us that goes looking for the edge. But out here it doesn't feel like punishment. It feels like an awakening. A celebration of what the mind and body can actually do when you stop negotiating with them.
We've learned not to ask each other how we're doing in the middle of these things. The question only makes you remember the pain. So instead we just say, "You're doing good, yah?" Not a question, really. A reminder. A small act of holding each other up across cold water.
We make a quiet trade in our marriage. He spent the last year and a half helping me through a Senate campaign -- knocking doors, holding the camera, holding me together on the hard nights. Now it's my turn. To watch the GPS track. To throw the bottle. To send calm seas across the water and trust that he knows how to do the hard thing.
You don't get to do anything this big alone. Behind every person attempting something impossible is a boat full of people who believe it's possible too.
I've lost friends to the mountains. I know how thin the line is between a story you tell at the finish and a story someone else has to tell for you. So I don't romanticize the risk. I'm just deeply proud of a person who decided one impossible thing wasn't enough, and went looking for the second.
Whatever happens out here today, he already did the hard part. He kept showing up.
If this stirred something in you -- some thing you've been afraid to start -- send it to the person you'd want in your boat.

Peter,

Your inbox looks like mine right now. _A mess_.

Would you be willing to volunteer for a unique campaign with a vision for building a new America together?

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/b03fa524197b/seattles-biggest-teslamusk-protest-yet-61304?e=10cc7d1928)

| |
**Peter — I’m running for Congress and I’m writing to tell you why.**
There are three key reasons:

1) I saw my mom suffer as a two time cancer survivor without health insurance. She died the year Obamacare came out. I will fight with everything I have to keep anyone else from enduring the many ways **our broken system punishes working people.**
2) I ran for this same office two years ago and was the ONLY candidate **warning about the threat to our democracy and the need to expand and reform the Supreme Court,** along with the rest of my plan.

**Amazingly, I am once again the only candidate for WA-02 who even mentions the threat we’re facing in the Voter's’ Guide**. We can’t win a fight we won’t acknowledge and we can’t tackle any of our priorities if we don’t win.
3) I believe in you, in US, and our ability to not just get through this crisis but **seize the opportunity to reimagine America.** We can build something we’ve never seen before, an America focused on you, your family, and your community instead of the rich and powerful.

**We can accomplish amazing, beautiful things together** but we won’t get there by electing the same career politicians that helped build the broken system that got us here in the first place.

I am uniquely qualified among the candidates for this position with proven experience accomplishing things people told me were impossible and the success I’ve had mobilizing thousands locally to fight for economic and social justice. **You can**[**read more**](https://us.list-manage.com/U3AnEas0u2b?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)**about that on my NEW website.**
---
| [SHOW ME THE SITE!](https://us.list-manage.com/DdxlBmSJZ1_?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)
---
| |
**I’M NOT GOING TO ASK YOU FOR MONEY!** This is usually where candidates ask you for a donation but not only am I not taking corporate money, I’m not accepting any donations.
**I want something more much valuable.** I want your partnership in making this campaign successful and reinventing America.
[**CLICK HERE**](https://us.list-manage.com/Um__kIYyWq2?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)**for our volunteer form** and join our merry band of change-makers ready to make history together. The incumbent may have all the money, but this can be our moment.
Excited to be on this journey with you.
— Devin

PS. Please join us on the social media sites below!

name: Bill Hill
subject: Why I have to fish instead of fundraise
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/115165?t=6&akid=25780%2E878179%2EPa3xWa) This isn’t typical during a campaign, but I'm about to largely go offline for more than a week.

I'm Bill Hill, and I'm running for Congress in Alaska. In a few days, I'll be leaving the campaign trail and heading to Bristol Bay for the start of the world's largest wild sockeye salmon run, where I've been commercial fishing for most of my life.

Every summer, millions of salmon return to Bristol Bay in one of the greatest wild fisheries on Earth. The season only lasts a few short weeks, and when the fish are running, fishermen go to work. There's no asking the salmon to wait until after an FEC deadline.

So while most candidates spend the days before a major fundraising deadline calling donors, I'll be out on the water earning a paycheck and helping support my family.

That's the reality of running for Congress when you're not a millionaire.

[Will you split a contribution between my campaign and Voter Protection Project today to help keep this grassroots campaign moving while I'm out on the water?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/115165?t=7&akid=25780%2E878179%2EPa3xWa) | [CONTRIBUTE »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/115165?t=8&akid=25780%2E878179%2EPa3xWa)
---
Before I head out to fish, there's something I need you to know:

**This race is absolutely winnable.**

National Republicans know it. That's why they'll spend heavily to protect Nick Begich and keep this seat in Republican hands.

Alaskans have rejected Republicans before, and if we have the resources to compete, we can do it again.

My campaign has never taken a dime of corporate PAC money. We're building this campaign the same way I've built my life — through hard work and support from regular people.

While I'm out on the water, I won't be able to spend the days leading up to our FEC deadline making fundraising calls like other candidates do. That's why I'm asking for your help today:

[Will you split a donation between my campaign and Voter Protection Project before I head out to Bristol Bay? Every dollar helps us build the grassroots campaign we need to hit our FEC goal and win this race.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/115165?t=9&akid=25780%2E878179%2EPa3xWa)
[GIVE NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/115165?t=10&akid=25780%2E878179%2EPa3xWa)
---
Thank you for standing with me.

— Bill Hill 🏔️🎣

P.S. I'll be offline and out on the water ahead of the FEC deadline, but this campaign won't stop fighting. [Please split a donation between my campaign and Voter Protection Project today to help us keep building the grassroots movement that can win this race.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/115165?t=11&akid=25780%2E878179%2EPa3xWa)

disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Bennett for Governor · P
body:
I'm asking you to join me at the Bangor 4th of July parade and help show Maine what this campaign is building.

| | |
---
---
---
Dear Peter, [Are you able to join me at Bangor 4th of July Parade on Saturday July 4th.](https://www.supportrickbennett.com/7_4_bangor?e=939e09e235be96b0bea768d960703804&utm_source=bennettforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bangor_parade&n=1) This year’s 4th of July celebration carries special meaning. As we mark the 250th anniversary of our country, we have the chance to celebrate our independence, and to reflect on the kind of people we want to be and the kind of future we want to build together. Our founders gave us more than a nation. They gave us an example of courage, faith, determination, and a belief that free people, working together, can do extraordinary things. That spirit still lives here in Maine. It lives in people who care about their communities, who believe public service still matters, who know we can do better, and who are ready to roll up their sleeves and help build a stronger future together. That is why I am asking you to join me at [parade or event name]. I will be there to celebrate this remarkable milestone in our country’s history and to celebrate the values that still make America and Maine worth believing in: independence, responsibility, hard work, service, and the idea that our best days are built together. When we walk together, we send a simple message: that Maine’s future does not belong to cynicism, division, or politics as usual. It belongs to people who are willing to come together and do the work of self government with optimism, common sense, and faith in one another. **Here are the Details:** **Parade: Bangor 4th of July Parade** **Date: Saturday July 4th** **Time: 8:45am** **Meet-up Location: Corner of Wilson and Acme St. Brewer Maine** **RSVP:[Walk with me](https://www.supportrickbennett.com/7_4_bangor?e=939e09e235be96b0bea768d960703804&utm_source=bennettforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bangor_parade&n=2)** I would be honored to have you with me. Bring your family. Bring your friends. Come celebrate this historic day with us, and let’s show what it looks like when people come together in a spirit of pride, purpose, and hope.

name: Roy Cooper (via Cooper Victory Fund)
subject: I made a choice
body:
This race is too consequential to sit out. The stakes are too high.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1906%2E124072%2EZxDEm8)
| | | |
---
Peter, deciding to run for this U.S. Senate seat wasn’t easy.
I had planned on serving North Carolina from here at home. That’s why I was so humbled when North Carolinians twice elected me to be their Governor.
**But this Senate race is too consequential to sit out. The stakes are simply too high.**
I entered this race to fight for people like you, who’ve put your trust in me – and I have full faith that together, we can win. But tonight, we’re facing the biggest test yet of our grassroots movement’s strength:
After 11:59 p.m., we have to close the books on every dollar we’ve raised since April 1 and hand them over to the FEC. Before long, those numbers will be published for all to see – including our MAGA loyalist opponent, his megadonors and the entire GOP machine. [**_So with time running out to reach our ambitious $1.5 million goal, I’m personally asking you to help out by making your first $5 donation, right now._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk719&amount=5&t=8&akid=1906%2E124072%2EZxDEm8)
| | [DONATE](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk719&amount=5&t=9&akid=1906%2E124072%2EZxDEm8)
---
I’m running because our nation cannot afford two more years of unchecked Republican power in Washington. The attacks on health care, on democratic values and even on Americans – **they have to stop.**
Our leaders should be focusing on strengthening our communities by investing in public schools, securing health care access and prioritizing hardworking folks over the wealthiest few. That’s what I strove to do in North Carolina – and by the end of my time in office, we added thousands of jobs by expanding the clean energy economy, gave public school teachers statewide a much-needed raise, expanded Medicaid and more.
**This is the work I’m ready to continue as the next Senator from North Carolina. But that means we have to flip this seat from red to blue for the first time in a generation and take back the Senate for the people who elect us, which is easier said than done.**
I’ve never lost a race, but this one will be the most competitive of my career. It’s the best pick-up opportunity for Democrats this cycle, and our ability to flip the Senate hinges on us succeeding. That’s why far-right groups are already spending nearly $100 million so far to attack me – and experts expect this to be the most expensive Senate race ever, so they will spare no expense to help President Trump’s handpicked candidate buy his way to victory.
So if they see us missing goals like the one we set for tonight, they _will_ use this as an opportunity to strike. They _will_ flood the airwaves with millions more in attack ads to smear me, knowing that their investments are working as intended, because we _will not_ have enough funds to fight back.
[**_Chipping in $5, $25 or whatever amount is right for you before the end of the day won’t just help us close the gap in time; it’ll prove to everyone that momentum is on our side. So if you’re with us, Peter, please make it clear by making a donation right away._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk719&amount=5&t=10&akid=1906%2E124072%2EZxDEm8)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk719&amount=5&t=11&akid=1906%2E124072%2EZxDEm8)
---
| | [DONATE $25](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk719&amount=25&t=12&akid=1906%2E124072%2EZxDEm8)
---
| | [DONATE $50](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk719&amount=50&t=13&akid=1906%2E124072%2EZxDEm8)
---

If you made it this far, thank you so much for reading – and for all you do to help me flip this battleground seat blue.

Roy Cooper

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

## Bitcoin Was the Prototype
Say what you want about Bitcoin — it proved something the experts swore was impossible. It proved that millions of people want a way to store wealth that no government can print, freeze, or inflate away. That idea was radical in 2009. Today it's a trillion-dollar fact.
